title: Wayfare Pass Window Refund — Calculation Sheet
content:
# Window refund — calculation sheet (Wayfare Pass)

**Definition.** The window refund of a Wayfare Pass (rider membership) period fee returns the period fee in full. The period fee is the amount of the membership fee charge that paid the billing period in force. The refund is never below 0.00 and is rounded half up to the cent.

## Record read

| Item | Record |
|---|---|
| Period fee | The membership fee charge on the membership ledger for the period that began on the membership's current period start (the latest such charge) |

## Worked figures (hypothetical memberships)

| Plan | Fee charge that paid the period in force | Window refund |
|---|---|---|
| Wayfare Pass Plus Annual | 199.00 | 199.00 |
| Wayfare Pass Annual | 96.00 | 96.00 |
| Wayfare Pass Monthly | 9.99 | 9.99 |

A period paid by a charge of 64.00 has a window refund of 64.00: the amount is that of the charge, whatever the plan's listed fee.
